_comment: ZETAPHY mainnet deploy config for launch.js --network mainnet (docs/ZETAPHY-MAINNET-PROCEDURE.md, step 16). Public values only: never a key. EVERY ADDRESS HERE IS A FAKE PLACEHOLDER (repeated digits) and is refused: put the real ones. Unknown keys are refused. Values not given take the defaults shown.

identity._comment: NeuroIdentity + NeuroValidation (ERC-8004). web: the Neuro web page, https://<host>/web/ (example hosts are refused). Without this section the identity step is skipped.

vault._comment: RewardVault: 100% to NeuroJobs, or validatorsShare % (1-99) to validators (an address that rewards validators). Governance: the timelock. The deployer puts no coins in it.

dlmm._comment: The DLMM (UNAUDITED): governance is the timelock from its first block; its presets, ThreatRegistry and feeTo are set by the timelock batch the launch writes (proposal step). feeTo: null = the same as dex.feeTo.

nft._comment: NFT marketplace fee, 0-500 bps; feeRecipient: null = communityFund. Governance: the timelock.

oracle._comment: ZetaphyPythRelay relayers (keys that push Pyth prices; none = governance names them later) and threshold; pythZetaFeed: the Pyth ZTPHY/USD feed id, or null (no feed yet).

ai._comment: The AI map's contracts (src/mainnetai.js), every role to the timelock. committee: AI co-signers (empty = the timelock alone until governance sets them); poster: DataDAO poster (null = the timelock); hubHost: the host the hub's passkeys are made on; mailbox: a Hyperlane Mailbox on ZETAPHY for NeuroOracleSender (null = skipped). usefulWork.issuance: UsefulIssuance (mints nothing; a RewardVault recipient).

apps._comment: The hub's offline, audit, quantum and immune tabs' contracts (src/mainnetapps.js), every governance the timelock. All optional: auditTreasury (default: communityFund) gets post-certificate slashes and lost appeal bonds; auditRunnerMinAgreed: accepted NeuroJobs verdicts an audit runner needs; rescueMaturity: blocks before a QuantumRescue commitment counts; immuneMinAgreed: agreeing runners for an immune flag (2+).
